_doc: Single source of truth for input shortcuts. TWO LANES, kept strictly separate. WIRE shortcuts (simple, two-step) are rewritten into the outbound Anthropic request by the proxy middleware (tools/HME/proxy/middleware/00a_shortcuts_rewriter.js) -- they become real API messages to the model. MULTI-STEP shortcuts are LOCAL-SESSION: the UserPromptSubmit hook (tools/HME/event_kernel/claude_adapter.js) blocks the literal prompt and the PTY bridge (tools/HME/scripts/hme-claude.py) replays each step into the LIVE Claude Code REPL. A multi-step step like /compact is a REPL-local slash command that never travels over the API; placing it under simple/two-step would send the literal text to the model and counterfeit the action. RULE: the proxy reads ONLY simple+two-step; the adapter+bridge read ONLY multi-step. Loader: tools/HME/proxy/shortcuts_config.js (Node), tools/HME/scripts/hme-claude.py (Python).

simple.a: add all to todo.md, then do all
simple.h: if we were to consider the last several rounds to have been relatively restrained in focus, lacking overview thinking in comparison to the next phase, how can we get even more hypermeta with self-coherence to the point of subquantum depth and interstellar breadth? push until you think there's no more, then push an infinite amount further
simple.i: iterate deeper, pushing interstellar breadth and quark-level depth for hypermeta coherent intuitive ecstasy
simple.p: pretend you just awoke as a vivacious plasma ball, and as you view your last few turns, consider the last several rounds to have been relatively restrained in focus and lacking in overview thinking, in comparison to the next phase. How can we push the hypermeta envelope with self-coherence past the point of unfathomable subquantum depth and interstellar breadth? push until you think there's no more, then push an infinite amount further
simple.s: refocus, stop polishing screws on a sinking ship
simple.sa: you may use as many subagents as you'd like, just make sure each has a reasonably focused scope
simple.t: use the todo system described in the header of TODO.md to do the todos therein
simple.te: Describe in text what you were going to do next without using any tools

cc.description: Compact the live Claude Code session, then continue. /compact is a REPL-local command, never a wire message; the PTY bridge types each step into the live session with an idle-wait between them.

c&.description: Dynamic compact shortcut. A prompt like c&continue compacts the live Claude Code session, then types the text after c& as the next live prompt. The c& prefix is local-session only and never becomes an API message.

steps:
Use the native Read tool on every file path below before any prose response. Do not use Bash, cat, sed, grep, task-output polling, or summaries as substitutes.
$prompt
readq.description: PTY-bridge consult follow-up: forces the live Claude Code REPL to request native Read tool calls for the generated consult read queue.
